desc: Prepare U-Boot as the stage-2 loader that reads kernel+DTB+initramfs from a FAT32 USB stick, now the ONLY remaining untethered route: enrolled appended-payload is root-caused dead (done/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md) and chainload= from NVMe is dead (m1n1 nvme_init SErrors, done/2026-07-25-t6040-nvme-probe-result.md). m1n1 has no mass-storage/filesystem support at all; U-Boot does. PIVOTAL FIRST QUESTION, answer with source evidence before any build: does upstream AsahiLinux/u-boot (branch asahi) include a Type-C/ATC-PHY (or tipd/HPM) driver able to bring a USB-C port up in HOST mode by itself? If YES this bypasses the blocked HPM/SPMI host transition and is a major unlock; if NO, U-Boot inherits the same dependency and that must be stated plainly. Then design/build a T6040 stage-2 config (xHCI+DWC3 Apple variant, DART/IOMMU, USB_STORAGE, FAT), build twice byte-identically, pin hashes, and write a delivery preflight. Base: AsahiLinux/u-boot asahi @ 8aa706b2daa49b64102e44067d8514de8a26dc42, existing framebuffer-only prep in done/2026-07-23-t6040-uboot-noio-prep.md + patches/uboot-t6040-noio-prep.patch. OFFLINE ONLY: no rig, no enrollment, no kmutil/bputil, autoboot off by default. First live test must be a separately reviewed TETHERED m1n1 chainload of the U-Boot payload. DONE offline 2026-07-25: PIVOTAL ANSWER = NO. U-Boot's only ATC code is drivers/phy/phy-apple-atc.c, an explicitly-documented dummy (empty phy_ops; Kconfig: 'initialized sufficiently by previous stage firmware'); no tipd/TPS6598x/CD321x/HPM or SPMI code exists anywhere in the tree; xhci-dwc3 assumes a pre-existing host-capable link. On M3/M4 m1n1's SPMI branch never touches the HPMs, and the T6040 ticket-063 smoke proved inherited state yields root-hubs-only. So untethered-via-USB remains blocked behind R3 (096/097, NO-GO). Built the stage-2 target anyway (it is the m1n1-missing MSC/FAT/bootcmd layer): apple_t6040_stage2_defconfig = noio core + runtime DT-derived MMIO allowlist (pmgr syscons, t8110 USB DARTs, dwc3 regs; nothing else mapped; no NVMe/PCIe/WDT compiled) + xHCI/DWC3/DART/PMGR/USB_STORAGE/FAT, bootcmd baked, autoboot OFF; plus U-Boot-only DT variant dts/t6040-j614s-dcuart-uboot-stage2.dts (right port drd2; DebugUSB drd0 untouched; snps,dwc3 + generic pmgr-pwrstate fallbacks). Two container builds byte-identical; raw-payload zero-pad 481,136 B (Image runtime size 1,031,720). First live test = tethered chainload, own reviewed rig ticket, steps+pass/stop in done/2026-07-25-t6040-uboot-stage2-prep.md.
